environment.cpuScope: Main target rate4. Each Worker target is independently sent Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate before resuming. Per-target acknowledgement or unsupported error is retained; acknowledgement does not establish an exact physical slowdown.
environment.timing: Cold: navigation-to-three accepted-and-drawn charts plus two RAF, including activation. Zoom: main app view-start mark through actual chart-draw hook. Hover: request-to-accepted raw response. Separate Playwright action upper bounds include automation overhead. Paint trace retained; draw callbacks alone are not pixel proof.
environment.coldDefinition: Fresh browser context per sample, same browser process; OS disk caches are not flushed.
environment.taskManager: pending manual capture; CDP heap is not tab total
